notes: Structured metadata first, OCR only when the app exposes nothing. This connector exists so the OCR fallback is reached less often, not more.

fields.name: media_title
fields.description: Title of the item on screen, from Accessibility labels or, failing that, an OCR summary.

fields.name: module
fields.description: Module or lesson label when the surface exposes one.

fields.name: playback_state
fields.description: Coarse transport state, matched against a fixed list.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Playback timestamp as displayed. A position, not a duration of viewing.
